objective: Complete and verify Seed Pod P0 CLI, MCP, situate, and ESR behavior against the approved plan using the checkpoint core interfaces. Fix adapter or diagnostic gaps, add focused parity tests, and do not modify core runtime behavior.

project_context.relevant_subsystem: This track owns the user and agent surfaces: pods promote, pods references check, MCP mutation/read parity, and role, identity, ancestry, transaction, boundary-fault, and reference-audit diagnostics in situate and ESR.
project_context.task_fit: The checkpoint has initial adapters and report fields. This branch must test observable contracts and correct only surface-level or diagnostic defects while treating memory_seed/core.py as a fixed dependency.
project_context.downstream_use: The orchestrator will combine this branch with the separately reviewed kernel and fixture branches, then run full CLI/MCP/doctor/ESR parity and repository validation before seeking any landing decision.
non_goals: Do not edit core.py, fixtures, documentation or control files; implement P1 retrieval; merge; push; release; or silently broaden an interface.
